name: docs-fairy
description: Generate, record, sync, and improve project documentation with evidence-based diagnosis and Starlight doc sites.

interface.longDescription: Analyze the codebase and project history to generate READMEs, architecture docs, API/CLI references, changelogs, runbooks, ADRs, project histories, and incident records; automatically finish Korean prose when humanize-korean is available; detect stale docs via git diff or full audits with approval-gated fixes; improve doc quality; and scaffold or integrate Starlight documentation sites.
defaultPrompt: 최근 변경으로 낡은 문서가 있는지 진단해줘.
